summary: This CSS file styles the layout and appearance of the EventDetails component in the frontend of a DBMS application. It defines styles for the container, headings, paragraphs, and student list, including responsive design for smaller screens.
evidence: .detailsContainer styles the main container with padding, max-width, margin, background-color, border-radius, and box-shadow.
.detailsContainer h1 and h2 styles the headings with font sizes and margins.
.detailsContainer p styles the paragraphs with font sizes and margins.
.studentList styles the list with no bullet points, padding, margin, font size, and color.
.studentList li styles the list items with padding, background color, border-radius, margin, font size, and color.
.studentList li:hover styles the list items on hover with a different background color.
@media (max-width: 768px) styles the container for smaller screens with reduced padding and width.
